=== Source occurrence ===
The June 2017 document prints this partial with an <code>E</code> mark, power 3, ability 3, deploy 3, forfeit 5, Force-Attuned label and pilot/warrior icons. The partial does not show artwork, lore or destiny. Its game-text words match the full image first located in the 2018 repository import. Published partial: [[File:Dagobah-D-Captain-Needa-June-2017-partial.png|frameless|300px]].
